meta.method: p3s3_curve_derive (port of phase3_snapshot_curve.derive); table = monotone-capped, 20-candidate excess guard
meta.operating_point: ratio 3.0 for Stokes I (all bands) and Stokes V >= 41 MHz and wideband; ratio 2.0 for Stokes V 18-36 MHz - ADOPTED by Gregg 2026-09-06 ~11:1x UT. Cross-match sample positions are exempt from the removal (parent_curve_table.xm_exempt, Gregg 2026-09-06).
meta.S_definition: parent peak flux / cell median frame global rms
